# Tirumala Darshan Planner

> Independent planner for darshan at Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple, Tirumala (Andhra Pradesh, India). Built from TTD's public daily bulletins: free Sarva Darshan queue waiting time, pilgrims, tonsures and hundi, plus festival dates compared with last year and TTD online ticket (quota) release dates. Not affiliated with TTD.

Key facts:
- Waiting times are for the free Sarva Darshan queue only. ₹300 Special Entry Darshan and SSD token holders wait far less.
- TTD releases each month's ₹300 tickets online about three months ahead, on the 24th at 10:00 AM IST (rooms 3:00 PM). Book only on ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in.
- No broker can sell darshan or rooms. Report brokers to TTD Vigilance: 9866898630. TTD call centre: 155257.

## Data (JSON, updated twice daily)
- [today.json](https://tirumalatemple.in/data/today.json): latest bulletin, tithi, next release, upcoming festivals, weekday averages
- [bulletins.json](https://tirumalatemple.in/data/bulletins.json): every daily bulletin for the last two years
- [plan.json](https://tirumalatemple.in/data/plan.json): festival dates and quota release pattern
